scenarios.name: The Grand Cotillion
scenarios.flavorText: A famous heiress has just come of age; suitors from every family of note have gathered to win her favor. Can you outmanuever your rivals to secure the debutante's hand?
scenarios.primaryObjective: Players gain one victory point at the end of every round if a friendly noble is partnered with the debutante
scenarios.secondaryObjectives: Each key token is worth 1 victory point at the end of the game.
scenarios.specialRules: Key tokens represent knowledge of the debutante's preferences. As a minor action, you may remove a key token from your hand and gain a victory point.  At the end of the round, if you have a wits token still in your hand, you may exchange it for a key token.  On the debutante's turn, if she is adjacent to multiple leaders and one player has more key tokens in their hand, she will break her current partnership, and partner with the leader whose player has more key tokens in hand.
scenarios.scenarioEvent: Grand Cotillion Special Event: As an major action, leaders adjacent to her may become the debutante's partner this round.

npcs.name: The Debutante
npcs.description: The debutante starts in one of the middle squares of the map.  She waits to be invited to dance.  If she is ever unpartnered, she moves directly toward the center of the map.

scenarios.name: Treason and Treachery
scenarios.flavorText: Behind their public obeisance, the noblity scheme to prop a new ruler on the throne.  Can you reveal your rivals aims while keeping yours hidden?
scenarios.primaryObjective: Players gain one victory point at the end of every round if they have a friendly noble in each quadrant of the ballroom.
scenarios.secondaryObjectives: Players gain one victory point for every Key token left in their opponent's bag at the end of the game.
scenarios.specialRules: At the start of the scenario, each player places 3 Key tokens in their bag.  Key tokens represent evidence of treason.
scenarios.scenarioEvent: Treason and Treachery Special Event: This round, as a major action, a noble may replace a Key token in their hand with a Misinformation token.
scenarios.endConditions: Game ends after 12 rounds, or if a player loses by having 2 Key tokens revealed by the Marshal.

npcs.name: The Marshal
npcs.description: The Marshal does not dance, but patrols the ballroom, moving 3 spaces in a random direction each round.  For every noble adjacent to the Marshal after his move, their player must show a random token from their bag.  If it is a Key token, set it aside; otherwise, return it.  If a player has ever revealed 2 Key tokens, they lose.
